intersections.note: Spring Av ends at Winton Rd; Spring Grove Cemetery on the west side of Winton
Spring Av ends at Station Av; Station continues north onto 647
Chester runs east from Station only (lumber yard to the west)
Chester ends at Platt (25 ft); Platt's east face is continuous

Winton ends at Spring Grove, which continues west along the cemetery. Only the north face of Spring Grove (100 ft) is drawn; centre taken 50 ft (305 px) south of the face on the east side of Winton (y 7115). The cemetery corner on the west side of Winton is about 107 px higher (y 7008) and the single water pipe runs at y 7295, so the y value is uncertain by up to about 60 px
Station is 50 ft wide here. Spring Grove centre taken 305 px south of its north face (y 7210); the two water pipes are drawn at about +185 and +280 px from the face
Spring Grove centre taken 305 px south of its north face (y about 7283); east of Platt the north face starts to rise (Spring Grove begins its turn NE)

widths.note: 50 ft from the C.H.&D. railroad south to Spring Grove; 40 ft north of the railroad (at Spring Av)

ends.note: north end of Platt Av: its two faces (x 6185 and 6340) are closed by a cross line at y 4330 against the M. B. Farrin lumber yard; the area east of it is sheet 649

notes: Single panel. Winton Road (60 ft) down the left side with Spring Grove Cemetery west of it; Spring Av (40 ft) from Winton to Station Av; the C.H.&D. railroad crosses diagonally; Station Av (40 ft north of the railroad, 50 ft south of it) runs the full height to Spring Grove Av; Chester Av (50 ft) from Station east to Platt Av (25 ft, printed PLATT AV.) along the right edge; Spring Grove Av (100 ft) along the bottom edge, only its north face drawn, so its centreline is placed 50 ft south of that face and its picks carry some uncertainty in y. The Farrin-Korn and M. B. Farrin lumber yards fill the blocks; no alleys. The sheet is skewed slightly (Spring Av and Winton both drift about 0.9 percent).
